error_contract: Standard Foundation meaning: NSCocoaErrorDomain/256 is NSFileReadUnknownError, a generic classification, not POSIX errno256, proof of an actual read syscall, or an unsupported-protection verdict. Error codes require their domains.

NSUnderlyingErrorKey optionally identifies an underlying NSError. Its domain/code can establish what cause Foundation reports for this failed call. Presence, POSIX domain and a complete causal chain are not guaranteed. No retained MacOSX26.2 NSError.h/NSCocoaError.h was located; these are public API conventions, not a newly verified installed implementation mapping.

If the underlying domain is NSPOSIXErrorDomain, APP04's actual macro bytes identify EPERM=1, EACCES=13, EINVAL=22 and ENOTSUP=45. These distinguish reported permission/invalid-argument/unsupported categories; they do not identify open versus F_SETPROTECTIONCLASS, capture immediate syscall errno, or prove why that operation failed.

Retained public Utilities source lines268,274,282 passes reading:true when constructing protection-setter errors, so a read-category NSError is not inherently contradictory. Its precise installed call path is unproved; do not derive the failed branch from this source or generic code256.
minimal_capture: Keep the single owned public setter and existing BOOL/top-level domain/code. On failure inspect only error.userInfo[NSUnderlyingErrorKey] once; emit a closed state absent/nserror/non_nserror and, only for NSError, the existing closed domain category plus signed code. No recursive traversal, descriptions, arbitrary userInfo, paths or object dumps. A wrapped non-POSIX/absent cause remains unknown; never substitute zero as errno or read later thread-local errno as the syscall cause. Existing alarm, direct-child ownership, output bounds, inode custody, cleanup and strict class requirements remain unchanged.
limits: Recommend this narrow observability addition before any instrumentation; no promise that the key will resolve the cause. No setter retry, direct native setter, debugger, interposition, privilege change, capability/enforcement equivalence, or promotion of historical failures.
activity: Retained source/evidence and hash/text reads only; this concise receipt is the only write. No code edits, Git writes, builds/tests, CI, network, native execution, child agents or notifications.
